details.detail: Seat surround (new taupe niche: jambs, header, two dome lamps). This was the biggest gain. Extra renders from the ottoman (v1, 1A) and from ahead of the centre pair (v2, 1D/1G) match omaat_f9, f5 and f1 closely: the header with its corner lamps, the jambs down to the armrest and console, and the slim dark gap between the two centre niches. Relative tones are right: back/wood 0.47 in the model against 0.50 in f9.
Walls and caps. The squared cap (top at H+0.0625) reads like the real, flatter bullnose in q02 and s1, and no longer looks toy-like.

Aisle exterior. The two equal 0.50 m leaves with an open span of about 0.64 m, the dark frames, about 19 slats per leaf, the base LED line and the dark-wood fixed panel aft all match f7, f49 and pb_20 (22 ribs per leaf there, so the 0.024 pitch is right). The new problem is heavy moire: the slats turn into a diamond or woven pattern at any grazing angle, in both the cabin view and the studio.

Window-suite screen wall. The angled aisle pier with its blue-grey pill mirror, the lamp at the outer top corner, the 0.08 window wing, the table with its black lip and the aisle box now line up well with f10 (q03 crop). The mirror renders #2c3951 against #587aaa, about the same 0.5x factor as the rest of the cabin lighting.

Centre-suite screen wall. The mirror is still a 0.035 m slot (pw 0.085). There is also no fixed wood fin between the 1D and 1G screens: f3 shows a tall dark-wood fin rising from the lowered divider to near the top of the screens, and the model only has a thin taupe edge.
Window console. The taupe fascia over a near-black body, the trim line, the long floor grille, the tapered wood tray, the tilted keypad and the handset dock all match f7, f13 and f9.

Seat. In window suites the 0.72 seat, flush leg rest, upright back, seams and lavender pillow are good. The flap is now pad-like, but it renders 1.5x the back (#525759 vs #37322d in v1), where the real flap is about 1.05-1.1x the back (f9 #8d8f8a vs #837c72, f1 #555553 vs #4e4443). It also sits about 4 cm below the back top, where the real flap hangs over the top edge. In centre suites the 0.72 seat and the armrest overlap by 9 cm.
Ottoman. The cantilevered cushion on a taupe tray and rail over an open dark void, with a plinth, matches f10 in q03 and w_screen.

Bed. The rods are gone. The pad runs under the table (-0.10 to -2.06), and the duvet with its turned-down fold reads as bedding. Both pillows lie flat, where in f46 they stand up against the aft surround. The sun patches on the bed belong to lighting.
Centre divider. Lowered to 0.70 by default, which matches f5, f1 and f3. The top rail and tab are fine.
Seat plaque. The size and placement at the forward end of the wardrobe cap are right. The blue-violet text from commit 7244177 does not show: the '2G' text renders pure #efeeeb in q02.

issues.problem: The fluted door slats alias into a moire (diamond or woven pattern) at grazing and distant views
issues.detail: About 20 separate 0.017 m gBox slats per leaf, 8 mm proud of a dark gap plane, are narrower than a pixel beyond about 2 m. Without MSAA or mipmapping the leaves shimmer and show cross-hatching. This is the most visible artefact in the aisle views.
issues.evidence: q02_suiteAisle.png x 740-930 (2G/2K aisle faces, crop leaf2.png): woven cross-hatch. studio/s1_suiteW.png forward leaf (x 480-620): diamond lattice. Real pb_20 and omaat_f49: clean vertical ribs.
issues.fix: In the !lod exterior loop of suiteUnit, draw the slats as ONE gQuad per leaf (len-0.06 × H-0.30) with a stripe texture (an atlas rect 'flute': 1 px dark groove, 3 px light rib, repeated about 20 times, mipmapped). Alternatively keep the geometry only in the studio unit and pass lod-style flat leaves to the cabin. A cheaper option is to widen the slats to 0.020, cut the proud depth to 0.003 and raise fFluteGap to about '#463f37' so the contrast that aliases is halved.

issues.problem: Centre suites: no fixed dark-wood fin between the two screens at the forward end of the divider
issues.detail: With divUp=0 the divider is a 0.70 m wall for its full length, so the 1D and 1G screens touch across a thin taupe edge. In the real cabin the forward ~0.3 m of the divider is a fixed full-height dark straight-grain wood fin between the screens (it also acts as the screen wing on the divider side), and only the part aft of it lowers.
issues.evidence: omaat_f3.jpg x 450-560: tall wood fin between the 2D and 2G screens, with the divider lowered aft of it. omaat_f4.jpg: the same on row 1. q02_suiteAisle.png and v2: no fin.
issues.fix: In the center branch, always add B.add(gRBox(0.035, H-0.64, 0.30, 0.012, 2), M4.trs(-hx+0.0175, 0.64+(H-0.64)/2, -L+0.27), SEATMAT.fWood) with a thin fShell top rail at H. Shorten the lowering divider to z > -L+0.42 (length L-0.56, centre -L/2+0.14). The screen then needs a small offset: set wing = 0.035 for center, which pushes the pier further. See the width question.

issues.problem: Centre suites: the 0.72 seat and the armrest overlap by 9 cm, and the aisle-side niche jamb is buried in the wardrobe wall
issues.detail: With w 1.10: xa = 0.39, seatX = 0.02, and the armrest (ax ± 0.05) spans x 0.29-0.39 while the seat base, cushion and back span -0.34 to 0.38. The jamb at seatX+0.415 spans 0.385-0.485, inside the wardrobe (x ≥ 0.39), so the centre niche has no visible aisle-side jamb, unlike f5.
issues.evidence: Geometry from src/09d_suite.js (SW 0.72, shelfW 0.14, xa hx-0.16). omaat_f5.jpg: each centre seat has a taupe jamb between the seat back and the wood wardrobe face. v2 render: the header runs straight into the wardrobe.
issues.fix: Derive the seat width from the space: const SW = Math.min(0.72, xa - 0.10 - (xo + shelfW + 0.04)), which gives 0.63 for centre suites. Place the jambs at Math.min(seatX + SW/2 + 0.055, xa - 0.05) so the aisle jamb stays proud of the wardrobe face. Better still, widen the centre suite (see the question).

issues.problem: The headrest flap is far too light against the back (1.5x, real 1.05-1.1x) and floats below the top edge
issues.detail: fFlap '#868a88' against fFabric '#6c655d' with its tweed layer renders #525759 against #37322d in v1 and #4b5051 against #342f2a in v2. The flap centre is at local y 0.60 of a 0.725 back, so a strip of back fabric shows above it. The real flap hangs over the top edge.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9.jpg flap #8d8f8a, back #837c72. omaat_f1.jpg flap #555553, back #4e4443. omaat_f5.jpg flap #7a7a70, back #706058. v1 and v2 renders (scratch).
issues.fix: Shared SEATMAT line in 09_seats.js: fFlap: { c: '#72767a', r: 0.65, l: LAYER.leather }. In suiteUnit, move the flap to local y 0.64 with height 0.16, so its top meets the back top at 0.725. Add a 0.02 × 0.035 wrap strip over the top: gRBox(0.52, 0.02, 0.05, 0.008, 1) at BH (0, 0.722, -0.02), in fFlap.

issues.problem: The lit literature niche and its warm glow strip poke through the armrest top and the aisle-side jamb
issues.detail: The niche gRBox(0.05,0.10,0.20) at (xa-0.03, 0.66, -0.20) and the fWarm strip at (xa-0.056, 0.67, -0.20) overlap the armrest (y ≤ 0.645, z ≤ -0.23) and the jamb (z -0.22 to -0.10, y ≥ 0.66). Only a small taupe block with a bright white sliver shows in the gap between them.
issues.evidence: v1 render x≈345, y≈330: bright white notch beside the jamb foot. studio/seat_front.png x≈205, y≈280: small taupe block on the armrest top.
issues.fix: Delete these two lines. The armrest already carries a pocket (fInner panel at ax-0.051). If a lit pocket is wanted, put it in the armrest's inner face: gBox(0.004,0.06,0.16) at S·(ax-0.052, 0.50, -0.30), in fWarm.

issues.problem: The coat-hook rail sticks half out of the aisle-side jamb
issues.detail: The gRBox(0.02,0.018,0.10) at (xa-0.02, 1.16, -0.25) spans z -0.30 to -0.20, and the jamb covers z -0.22 to -0.10. The aft 2 cm is buried and the rest floats as a grey-blue stub.
issues.evidence: v1 render x≈325, y≈172. studio/seat_front.png x≈190, y≈148 (the flap.png zoom shows the stub).
issues.fix: Move the hook forward of the jamb, to z -0.34, and give it a 0.03 base plate against the wood (x xa-0.005), or delete it. It is not visible in f9 or f5.

issues.problem: The plaque's blue-violet text does not render
issues.detail: The quad material { ...tagGlow, c: '#8f9cff' } still gives white glyphs. The atlas draws the text '#efe7da' and LAYER.atlasGlow apparently ignores c.
issues.evidence: q02_suiteAisle.png '2G': glyph pixels #efeeeb. omaat_f49 and f9 '2K': blue-lit text.
issues.fix: In 06_atlas.js (shared, one line), fill F-cabin tags with '#9aa6ff' (s.cls === 'F' ? '#9aa6ff' : '#efe7da'). Or make atlasGlow multiply by c.

issues.problem: The open triangular pocket behind the angled aisle pier can be seen from above
issues.detail: The pier runs at 45°/55° from (pX0, -L+0.135) to the outer wall. Neither the front-wall cap (z ≤ -L+0.126) nor the outer-wall cap (x ≥ hx-0.046) covers the triangle behind it (about 0.11 × 0.11 m at H), so from high views it shows as a dark notch at the top of the pier.
issues.evidence: q02_suiteAisle.png crop, top right of the 2G screen at the aisle corner: dark sliver between the pier top and the cap.
issues.fix: Add a taupe top plate: gRBox(hx-pX0+0.01, 0.02, 0.13, 0.006, 1) at (pX0+(hx-pX0)/2, H+0.01, -L+0.19) in fCap. Or extend the front-wall cap depth to 0.26 on the aisle side.

issues.problem: Bed pillows lie flat on the pad
issues.detail: The white and lavender pillows are flat cushionSecs slabs at y 0.52-0.56. In the real bed they stand propped against the folded seat back or aft surround.
issues.evidence: omaat_f46.jpg: the white pillow stands, with the lavender pillow in front of it, leaning on the aft panel. q04_suite1Abed.png: flat white block and lilac slab.
issues.fix: In the bed branch, tilt the white pillow up (rx about -65°) at z -0.20, y 0.62, and the lavender one about -55° at z -0.33, y 0.56.

issues.problem: The interior renders about 2x darker than the photos (lighting area)
issues.detail: Mentioned only briefly. The relative tones are right; overall exposure is not.
issues.evidence: q03 ottoman #433e38 vs f10 #927f78. v1 back #37322d vs f9 #837c72.
issues.fix: Belongs to the lighting owner (12_scene.js). Also note the blocky sun patches on the bed and seat in q04 and v1.

questionsForUser: Photos (omaat_f3, f5) show the centre suites with a full-size mirror pier AND a wood fin between the two screens, which cannot fit in the modelled 1.10 m (the mirror is now a 3.5 cm slot and the seat overlaps the armrest). Do you have an F cabin drawing or LOPA with suite widths, or may I widen the centre suites to about 1.22 m and take the difference from the two aisles?

Should the suite doors support a closed state (two fluted leaves meeting at a centre pull, with the wood fixed walls showing), for example toggled from the seat bar? Many real photos (pb_20, omaat_f49) show them closed.
